question:
**Fill in the blanks:**

The Santosh Trophy 2022-23 final was uniquely held in _____, where Karnataka defeated Meghalaya to win the title after 54 years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Riyadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Santosh Trophy 2022-23 final** was held in **Riyadh, Saudi Arabia**. This was the first time the tournament was organized **outside India**, making it a unique event in the history of the Santosh Trophy.
 
• The final match took place between **Karnataka** and **Meghalaya**. Karnataka defeated Meghalaya to win the title **after a gap of 54 years**.
 
• The match was hosted at the **King Fahd International Stadium** in Riyadh, a renowned venue for international football matches.
 
• The decision to hold the final in Riyadh was part of an effort to promote Indian football internationally and to engage with the **Indian diaspora in Saudi Arabia**.
 
• This victory marked Karnataka’s **fifth Santosh Trophy title**, with their last win being in 1968-69.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santosh Trophy:**

 
 
• The Santosh Trophy is a prestigious **inter-state football tournament in India**, organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**.
 
• It was established in **1941** and is named after the late Maharaja Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh, a prominent patron of football in India.
 
• Over the years, it has been a platform for discovering young and talented football players from across the country.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka’s Performance:**
 
 
• Karnataka has now won the Santosh Trophy title **five times**, with their first win in **1946**.
 
• The 2022-23 win was a significant achievement as it ended a **54-year drought for the team** in the tournament.
 
 
 
• **King Fahd International Stadium:**
 
 
• Located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, this stadium is a major venue for international football events.
 
• It has a seating capacity of over **68,000 spectators** and is known for hosting significant matches, including the AFC Champions League and Saudi Pro League games.
 
 
 
• **Indian Football Abroad:**
 
 
• Hosting the Santosh Trophy final in Riyadh reflects the growing efforts to **globalize Indian football**.
 
• It aims to connect with the large **Indian expatriate community** in the Middle East and promote the sport beyond national borders.
